2608.20256.title: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Reasoning for Test-Time Compute Allocation
2608.20256.paper_summary: Reasoning language models trained with reinforcement learning typically operate under a fixed token budget rather than an explicitly adaptive one, which can lead to over-computation on easy problems and insufficient computation on difficult ones. We study whether a model can learn to allocate its own reasoning effort by choosing, as the first token of its response, one of three modes: \textsc{NoThink} (answer as quickly as possible), \textsc{Short} (brief reasoning), or \textsc{Long} (extended reasoning). The choice is learned inside Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with no separate router, through a shaped reward that makes each mode worthwhile at a different response length, together with hard per-mode token caps that keep the modes distinct. On a 1.5B distilled model trained on MATH, the three modes emerge without collapsing to a single choice, and the brief modes end up more accurate than \textsc{Long}, which shows that the router sorts problems by difficulty rather than at random. Averaged over three seeds, the resulting policy stays close to the base model's accuracy on the held-out MATH500 ($0.782$ vs.\ $0.796$) while cutting the mean response length from $4{,}796$ to $2{,}811$ tokens (a $41\%$ reduction). Interestingly, it also transfers to other benchmarks without retraining, with the largest savings where problems are easier, with for instance 76\% token reduction on GSM8K and at higher accuracy than the baselines at similar response length. In short, we build a reasoning model that adaptively chooses how much to reason for each problem.
2608.20256.paper_summary_zh: 推理語言模型通常在固定的標記預算下運作，而不是明確自適應的預算，這可能導致在簡單問題上過度計算，而在困難問題上計算不足。我們研究模型是否可以通過選擇作為其回應的第一個標記的三種模式之一來學習分配自己的推理努力：\textsc{NoThink}（儘快回答）、\textsc{Short}（簡短推理）或\textsc{Long}（擴展推理）。這一選擇是在無需單獨路由器的群體相對策略優化（GRPO）中學習的，通過一種塑造的獎勵，使每種模式在不同的回應長度上都有其價值，並且有嚴格的每模式標記上限，以保持模式的區別。在一個基於MATH訓練的1.5B蒸餾模型上，這三種模式在不崩潰為單一選擇的情況下出現，並且簡短模式的準確性最終超過了\textsc{Long}，這顯示路由器是根據問題的難度進行排序，而不是隨機的。平均三個種子，結果策略的準確性接近基準模型在保留的MATH500上的準確性（$0.782$對$0.796$），同時將平均回應長度從$4{,}796$減少到$2{,}811$標記（減少$41\%$）。有趣的是，它還可以在不重新訓練的情況下轉移到其他基準上，並且在問題較簡單的地方節省最大，例如在GSM8K上減少76\%的標記，並在相似的回應長度下達到比基準更高的準確性。簡而言之，我們建立了一個推理模型，能夠自適應地選擇對每個問題進行多少推理。
